title: Reconcile and prepare exact admission-family performance measurement
summary: Rebind the admission cell space to the reviewed family catalog, add exact performance-only A0-A7 runtime authorization, preserve the deterministic dry-run campaign, complete the selected A0/A3/A4/A7 pilot, and execute the authorized counterbalanced A0-A7 follow-on through the ProtocolLab rack package boundary.
planned_changes: Keep factor-cell-space v3 and all retained timing-disabled and pilot controls immutable; preserve the exact manifest-bound performance-only admission token and production-seam package path; add an additive all-eight control and deterministic compiler that expands an eight-block Williams balanced Latin square into 64 one-repetition jobs; build one exact package per cell and reuse it across blocks; checkpoint every attempt for exact-identity resume; require bounded server output and sampled load-process telemetry while requesting target runtime counters; retain controller artifacts; and report cell, main, two-factor, and three-factor effects without accepting or activating a policy.
verification_plan: Validate all new canonical JSON against its schema and recompute hashes; prove every A0-A7 cell occupies every position once and every ordered first-order predecessor pair occurs once; prove fixture and 64-run manifest replay are byte-identical; reject unbalanced order, bounded cells, covering-array intent, outside axes, stale hashes, wrong host or workload, correctness intent, active intent, and performance-acceptance intent; prove package reuse, operator pause, and exact-identity resume; run focused runtime and package authorization tests; build source, raw server, adapter, and tests in Release; execute 64 isolated-pair one-repetition jobs; verify package identity, topology, payload bytes, runtime cell identity, activation and release accounting, failed and timeout counts, sampled load resource data, bounded output, and checksums; derive the declared full-factorial contrasts; validate the four touched SpecTrace artifacts directly; and run git diff --check.
completion_notes: The independently hosted A0/A3/A4/A7 pilot completed on plab-worker-x64-02 and plab-worker-x64-03 from clean source fc82651ce20ec2cdd55a5ea6c902e9ff285bd13d. All eight repetitions transferred exact bytes with zero failures and timeouts, and compact server evidence stayed below 43,740 bytes. Canonical pilot result 2887fed8f5769acbd90bafaf18418f0de81ed8f969ad2c23705e422f292ff610 remains directional because two serial repetitions cannot isolate batch from buffer or control execution-order drift. On 2026-07-29 the user authorized the additive all-eight counterbalanced follow-on on the same x64-02/x64-03 pair. Its deterministic control, compiler, resumable runner, bounded evidence checks, sampled load metrics, requested target counters, and focused contract test are implemented; rack execution and full-factorial reconciliation remain in progress.
out_of_scope: Accepting a performance policy or activating an adaptive rule
CI modification, push, or deletion of retained evidence
Presenting a local dry run or topology-incomplete rack run as credible performance evidence
Treating the balanced campaign as independent-host or independent-workload validation
